newsitem.title: USA: Brazil coffee belt to turn cool, but no frost seen.
newsitem.headline: Brazil coffee belt to turn cool, but no frost seen.

text.p: Temperatures are expected to turn cooler in Brazil this weekend, but no frost or freezing temperatures are expected to reach the coffee belt, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Monday.

The latest indications are for cold weather and a high pressure system to build into Argentina during the second part of this week. The system will move across Uruguay and far southern Brazil next weekend, WSC said.

The forecast calls for mostly fair skies and warm temperatures during today and Tuesday. A few showers may reach the southern belt during Wednesday. Temperatures will continue to average in the 50's and 60's F (teens C).

Scattered showers will spread south to north during Thursday and Friday. Temperatures should average above normal Thursday, cooler during Friday and the weekend. WSC said the lowest temperatures may drop into the 40s F in the south belt.
The extended outlook for next week shows the cooler trend continuing, WSC said.
